description:
Guyal is a fine jewelry brand specializing in IGI-certified lab-grown diamond jewelry crafted in 925 sterling silver and 24K gold vermeil. The brand offers an elegant range of rings, necklaces, earrings, bracelets, and piercings designed for everyday wear, milestone moments, and meaningful gifting. With a focus on ethical sourcing, hypoallergenic craftsmanship, and accessible luxury, Guyal makes real diamonds attainable through transparent pricing, free insured shipping, and a 7-day return promise, blending modern design with timeless quality.

The Guyal ChatGPT App gives users access to their general business information such as website and contact email address. The app also allows users to discover Guyal's product offerings and allows users to submit queries to the Guyal team.
